get.summary: Render a document as PNG or PDF
get.description: Returns the file in the JSON body, base64-encoded in `data`. PNG defaults to width 1280, light theme and a mouse; width, theme and `touch` (a touch screen, as a phone or tablet has) select its viewport. A PNG is as wide as the page lays out, so one wider than `width` shows the page scrolls sideways. PNGs over 16 megapixels are refused. `paper` and `orientation` set the page; the document prints light whatever theme its reader uses. A file over 3 MB encoded is refused with 413, and 503 means this server has no page renderer to print with.

anyOf.description: Rejected: Mermaid is not a write format; convert it in the browser

mermaid.description: Rejected: Mermaid is not a write format; convert it in the browser

get.summary: Render a drawing as SVG or PNG
get.description: Returns the image in the JSON body: `data` is the SVG source when `format=svg`, and the PNG base64-encoded when `format=png`, as `encoding` says. `scale` multiplies the raster and is ignored by `svg`. SVG text names the Excalidraw font families without embedding them, so a viewer without them installed substitutes; the PNG is drawn with the fonts this server carries. Two ceilings apply: a raster over 16 megapixels is refused with 400, and an encoded image over 3 MB with 413. A smaller `scale`, or `svg`, answers either.

schema.description: Raster pixels per scene unit, 1 to 4; png only.

width.description: The image's own size: pixels for png, scene units for svg, which may be fractional.

post.summary: Revoke the token this request carries
post.description: For signing a device or a CLI out. Every later request with the token is a 401; other tokens are untouched.

post.summary: Trade a native sign-in code for a personal access token
post.description: The code arrives at the app's callback after the user approves at /native-sign-in; it is single-use and expires a minute after it is issued. `codeVerifier` is the PKCE verifier behind the S256 challenge sent there, and `redirectUri` the callback it was sent with. Answers a write-scope token named for the device. Every failure is the same 400, and a spent code presented again with its verifier revokes the token it was first traded for.

ErrorResponse.title: Error response
ErrorResponse.description: The body of every unsuccessful response.

code.description: Stable error code; clients branch on this, not the text.

issues.description: The input validation failures behind a 400, when any.

data.description: Machine readable detail; each field is null on the errors that do not carry it.

currentUpdatedAt.description: On a 409, the document's current `updatedAt`; re-read from it and retry with it as `ifUnmodifiedSince`.

blockIndex.description: Position among the document's top-level blocks, from 0.

tag.description: The heading level as Lexical stores it, such as `h2`.

candidates.description: On a 400 from an ambiguous `afterHeading`, the headings it could have meant; pass one's `nth` to choose.
